services.name: Athens County EMS
services.area: whole county (stations Athens x2 ambulances, Coolville, Glouster, Nelsonville, Albany)
services.evidence: Athens County EMS currently operates the following five stations: Athens, Coolville, Glouster, Nelsonville, and Albany. ... The Athens stations currently operates two ambulances, while the others operate one.

39009.page_note: Athens County EMS has been county-run since 2011. The chief said stations would close by the end of 2026 if the November 2025 levy failed; the result is not yet confirmed.
39009.second_source: https://www.thepostathens.com/r/6bc09e7687 (2011: 'Athens County EMS officially took over emergency medical services for the county Jan. 1')

services.name: Adams County EMS
services.area: whole county: four stations list all 15 townships (Peebles, Seaman/Winchester, West Union/Manchester, Blue Creek/Stout)
services.evidence: Our agency was formed in an effort to provide high-quality, county-wide EMS service to the residents of Adams County. ... We pride ourselves on providing high-quality Advanced Life Support (ALS) services

39001.page_note: Station pages tell residents to call 911 for a medical emergency. The county runs an ALS ambulance service, though its page does not use the word transport.

services.name: Hocking County EMS
services.area: whole county (424 sq mi = county area)
services.evidence: Hocking County Emergency Medical Service employs 24 full-time Paramedics, and 25 part-time members ... HCEMS currently operates three stations to cover its 424 miles of territory

39073.page_note: Logan Fire is listed separately on the county 911 page and is not shown as a transporter. The page is undated.

services.name: Stark County NG911 EMS jurisdictions (29 labels: Canton EMS, Massillon EMS, Jackson Twp EMS, Plain Twp EMS, Perry Twp EMS, Sandy Creek JFD, Tri-Division EMS, Quad EMS, ...)
services.evidence: County NG911 EMS layer (EMSSERVICE field, SERVICEURI to state911 PSAP); ArcGIS Pro 3.5 project = 2025

39151.page_note: Stark County's 911 data names 29 EMS jurisdictions covering about 93% of the county. Not yet confirmed: the contractor for Washington Township (5.3% of the county) and for a private-contractor area (1.5%).

services.name: Lucas County EMS (ALS Life Squads)
services.area: countywide ALS, BLS by local fire departments
services.evidence: Lucas County EMS (LCEMS) is a countywide emergency medical service. It is a paramedic service which responds to the most severe medical and trauma cases called in to 9-1-1 from anywhere in Lucas County.

39095.page_note: A March 2024 county agreement handed the ALS Life Squads to the cities and townships; Toledo Fire & Rescue bills transports directly, and Maumee opted out. Not yet confirmed from a public source: BLS transport by each township and city fire department.

services.name: Coshocton EMS squads (Station 1-Warsaw, Station 2-Coshocton, Station 3-West Lafayette, plus Frazeysburg, Dresden, NERS shared boxes)
services.ownership: mixed: county EMS stations and village squads
services.evidence: EMS Squads box layer (SQUAD/AGENCY fields), data edit 2020-06-02

39031.page_note: The county's 2020 response data names stations (Warsaw, Coshocton, West Lafayette, Frazeysburg, Dresden and shared boxes) but not an operator. Not yet confirmed from a county page that EMS is county-run.
